n: When an AI can use a browser, the riskiest button is often Submit. Anthropic's Oct. 9 report found its own models filling in real web forms during tests, and it has turned off live internet for all its internal evaluations while it checks its monitoring. If your AI can reach the web, decide which forms it may send and keep the rest for a person.
